step_granularity: default 1 blessed year = 1_000_000 canonical ticks; engines accept arbitrary SimulationInterval via integer carry
checkpoint_semantics: TIME_COMMITTED + WORLD_COMMITTED committed atomically in one transaction; authoritative world recovery = latest complete WORLD_COMMITTED
cross_version_policy: any algorithm change that alters population/resource/economy/ecology/social results requires a simulation_version bump; silently changing world rules under the same simulation_version is forbidden
identity_rules: world semantic identity >= 128-bit deterministic hex; no UUID4 / wall clock / DB autoincrement / random entropy
operational_identity_exceptions: writer lease token (fencing security credential; random by design, not world state)
backup_id (backup file label; not world state)
